_about: Single source for the support tables and the contributors block. Edit here, then run: python scripts/render_support.py (README files) / --notes TAG (release notes). Contributors come from .all-contributorsrc. Lights: 🟢 real device or release gate, 🟡 CI/eval only, ⚪ untested or unsupported, — same language. Evidence for each light goes in the release notes' developer section.

legend.en: 🟢 tested on a real device or in the release gate · 🟡 tested only in CI or the eval, not yet on a real device (Windows install: the setup wizard; the portable zip is real-device tested. CPU-only: latency not measured on a real laptop) · ⚪ not tested yet or not supported · — same language

download: - **Windows 10/11**: [tinglongwu-setup-{ver}.exe]({base}tinglongwu-setup-{ver}.exe). Run it, accept the license, then keep clicking **Next**; stay online while it downloads about 3 GB of packages plus 2-3 GB of models (10-40 minutes).
SmartScreen says "Windows protected your PC"? Click **More info**, then **Run anyway** (the installer is not code-signed).
It needs Homebrew and asks for your Mac password while installing the BlackHole audio driver (typing shows nothing). If a step fails, run the same command again.
Run it as a normal user, not root. If system packages are missing it asks `Install them now with apt (uses sudo)? [y/N]`; answer `y` (or set `TLWU_YES=1`).
